student_500.name: Student Visa (Subclass 500)

work_rights.note: Breaching the 48-hour limit is a visa condition breach and may affect your visa

key_conditions: Must remain enrolled in and actively studying a registered CRICOS course
Must maintain Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for the duration of your visa
Must achieve satisfactory course progress (usually 50% pass rate)
Must notify your education provider and DHA of address changes within 7 days
Must maintain contact with your education provider

graduate_485.name: Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485)
graduate_485.description: Allows international graduates to live, study and work in Australia after completing their studies

graduate_work.name: Graduate Work stream
graduate_work.requirement: Qualification in an occupation on the relevant skilled occupation list

graduate_485.deadline: Must apply within 6 months of receiving final results
graduate_485.study_requirement: Degree must be from an Australian institution

skilled_189.name: Skilled Independent Visa (Subclass 189)
skilled_189.description: Points-based permanent visa for skilled workers with no requirement for employer or state sponsorship
skilled_189.process: Submit Expression of Interest (EOI) via SkillSelect, receive invitation, lodge application
skilled_189.skills_assessment: Required from relevant assessing authority before lodging EOI

skilled_190.name: Skilled Nominated Visa (Subclass 190)
skilled_190.description: Points-based permanent visa requiring nomination by a state or territory
skilled_190.commitment: Must live and work in the nominating state for at least 2 years
skilled_190.points_bonus: Nomination adds 5 points to your score

skilled_491.name: Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) Visa (Subclass 491)
skilled_491.description: For skilled workers to live and work in regional Australia
skilled_491.pathway_to_pr: Can apply for 191 (permanent) after 3 years in regional Australia
skilled_491.points_bonus: Nomination/sponsorship adds 15 points to your score

tfn.name: Tax File Number (TFN)
tfn.description: A unique 9-digit number used for tax and superannuation purposes
tfn.how_to_apply: Apply online at ato.gov.au — use your ImmiAccount credentials if you applied for visa online
tfn.never_share: Never share your TFN unless required by employer, bank or super fund

income_tax.name: Income Tax Rates (2024-25)
income_tax.tax_free_threshold: Only available to Australian tax residents. Most student visa holders on temporary visas are NOT residents for tax purposes in their first year.
income_tax.non_resident_rate: 32.5% on every dollar earned (no tax-free threshold) for non-residents
income_tax.lodge_tax_return: Lodge at mytax.ato.gov.au each year by 31 October

superannuation.name: Superannuation (Super)
superannuation.description: Australia's retirement savings system. Employers must pay a percentage of your earnings into a super fund.
superannuation.eligibility: All employees including visa holders with work rights are entitled to super
superannuation.minimum_threshold: No minimum earnings threshold — all employees entitled to super from first dollar earned (as of 1 July 2022)

dasp.name: Departing Australia Superannuation Payment (DASP)
dasp.description: You may be able to claim your super back when you permanently leave Australia
dasp.eligibility: Your visa has expired or been cancelled, and you have left Australia
dasp.tax_rate: 35% for working holiday makers, 65% for others on super savings (withholding tax)

medicare.name: Medicare
medicare.eligibility_for_student_visas: Most student visa holders are NOT eligible for Medicare

rhca_countries.description: Citizens of countries with a Reciprocal Health Care Agreement (RHCA) may be eligible for some Medicare benefits

oshc.name: Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)
oshc.requirement: Mandatory for all student visa holders — must hold for the full duration of your visa
oshc.what_it_covers: Hospital, limited GP, ambulance, some mental health services
oshc.cost_estimate: Approx AUD 600–800/year for single cover (varies by provider)
oshc.bulk_billing: Some GPs bulk bill OSHC holders — always ask 'do you bulk bill OSHC?'

emergency.ambulance: 000 (Triple Zero) — free call for life-threatening emergencies

minimum_wage.name: National Minimum Wage
minimum_wage.casual_loading: 25% loading for casual workers (so $30.13/hr minimum for casuals)
minimum_wage.applies_to: All workers with legal work rights in Australia, regardless of visa type
minimum_wage.check_award_rates: Many industries have higher award rates — check at fairwork.gov.au/pay

rights.name: Your Work Rights in Australia
key_rights: Right to receive at least the minimum wage for every hour worked
Right to payslips within 1 working day of pay day
Right to a safe working environment
Right to be free from workplace discrimination and harassment
Right to take leave (annual, sick, parental — after 12 months casual or permanent)
All rights apply equally regardless of visa status if you have work rights
rights.check_visa_work_rights: vevo.homeaffairs.gov.au — verify your visa's work conditions

report_underpayment.note: Anonymous tip-offs are welcome — visa status will not be used against you

work.tfn_for_work: Provide your TFN to employer to avoid 47% tax withholding. Your employer cannot refuse to employ you if you don't have one yet.
work.payslips: Employers must provide payslips within 1 working day of each pay period

overview.name: Opening a Bank Account in Australia
overview.best_time_to_open: You can open an account before arriving — up to 3 months in advance at major banks

digital_options.name: Up Bank
digital_options.note: Great app, no fees, easy setup

digital_options.name: ING
digital_options.note: No ATM fees if you deposit $1000+/month

international_transfers.wise: Wise (wise.com) — best exchange rates, low fees for sending money home
international_transfers.avoid: Avoid over-the-counter bank transfers — high fees and poor rates

rental_process.name: Renting in Australia
typical_requirements: Employment letter or proof of income/savings (bank statements)
References from previous landlords or employers
100 points of ID (each document has a point value)

upfront_costs.bond: Usually 4 weeks rent (maximum in most states)
upfront_costs.total_upfront: Around 6 weeks rent to move in

tips: Apply to multiple properties at once — competition is high in Sydney and Melbourne
Include a short cover letter about yourself with your application
Flatmates.com.au is the easiest way to find an affordable share house room
Inspect the property before signing anything
rental_process.bond_return: Bond is lodged with the state bond authority, not the landlord — you get it back at end of tenancy if no damage

sydney.student_discount: 50% off public transport for eligible tertiary students
sydney.suburb_tips: Students often live in Kingsford/Kensington (near UNSW), Ultimo/Glebe (near UTS/USyd), or Parramatta for affordability

melbourne.student_discount: Concession myki for eligible full-time students
melbourne.free_tram_zone: Free tram travel in the CBD Free Tram Zone
melbourne.suburb_tips: Carlton (near UniMelb), Fitzroy, Brunswick for affordable share housing

brisbane.student_discount: Concession go card for eligible students
brisbane.note: Host city for 2032 Olympics — major infrastructure investment ongoing

perth.free_cat_buses: Free CAT (Central Area Transit) buses in Perth CBD

adelaide.note: Most affordable Australian capital city for students

darwin.note: Tropical climate, smaller population, excellent for regional pathways

hobart.note: Cheapest of Australia's capital cities, cooler climate

unidays.description: Student discounts on clothing, tech, food and more — verify with your .edu.au email

discounts.spotify_student: 50% off Spotify Premium with student verification at spotify.com/au/student
discounts.transport_concession: Apply for concession opal/myki/go card through your university — usually free or minimal cost

emergency_contacts.international_student_support: Contact your university's international student office for any crisis

useful_websites.vevo: vevo.homeaffairs.gov.au — Check your visa conditions and work rights
useful_websites.my_tax: my.gov.au — Lodge tax returns, manage TFN and super
useful_websites.fair_work: fairwork.gov.au — Check wages and work rights
useful_websites.study_australia: studyaustralia.gov.au — Official Australian government study guide
